title: Expression and phosphorylation state analysis of intracellular protein kinases using Multi-PK antibody and Phos-tag SDS-PAGE
author: Sugiyama, Katayama, et al.

steps.title: Homogenize rat tissues
steps.instruction: Homogenize each rat tissue (cerebrum, cerebellum, medulla oblongata, heart, lung, stomach, small intestine, large intestine, spleen, liver, kidney, testis, muscle) in 10 volumes of ice‑cold 5 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 7.6 buffer containing 0.5 mM EGTA, 1 mM EDTA and 1 mM phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride using a Polytron homogenizer (Kinematica AG).

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenates
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenates at 20,000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C; collect the supernatant as crude extract.

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration of each extract using the Bensadoun and Weinstein method with BSA as the standard.

steps.title: Add sample buffer and boil
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 2× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer to each extract, mix, and boil for 10 min.

steps.title: Starve INS‑1 cells
steps.instruction: Plate INS‑1 cells in 10‑cm dishes and incubate in serum‑free RPMI‑1640 for 6 h to induce starvation.

steps.title: Treat INS‑1 cells
steps.instruction: For phosphorylation induction, add either 10 µM Forskolin and incubate 10 min, or 1 µM okadaic acid and incubate 1 h, keeping cells in the same 10‑cm dishes.

steps.title: Treat HL‑60 cells
steps.instruction: Plate HL‑60 cells in 10‑cm dishes and incubate with 10 µM each of axitinib, cabozantinib, pazopanib, and vandetanib for 3 days.

steps.title: Add sample buffer to cells
steps.instruction: After treatment, collect the cells and resuspend each pellet in 150 µL (or 500 µL) SDS‑PAGE sample buffer.

steps.title: Dephosphorylate lysates (optional)
steps.instruction: Dephosphorylate the cell lysates with lambda protein phosphatase (λPPase) according to the previously described protocol.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins with TCA
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 20 % trichloroacetic acid to each lysate, mix, and keep on ice to precipitate proteins.

steps.title: Wash protein pellets
steps.instruction: Centrifuge to collect the precipitated pellets, wash each pellet with ice‑cold acetone, and briefly air‑dry.

steps.title: Redissolve and boil pellets
steps.instruction: Dissolve the washed pellets in 2× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer, vortex, and boil for 10 min.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load the boiled samples onto either conventional SDS‑PAGE or Phos‑tag SDS‑PAGE gels and run electrophoresis under standard conditions.

steps.title: Western blot detection
steps.instruction: Transfer the separated proteins to a membrane and probe with Multi‑PK (or YK34) antibodies; detect bands using appropriate secondary antibodies and chemiluminescence.
